Parley now suggests your next line while a meeting records. When the other side finishes a sentence, the 教練 (Coach) tab offers one thing to say; when the conversation goes quiet, it offers a few full sentences to move it on. After the meeting, the report shows how many of them you actually said.

**Live suggestions** (#723)

- Turn them on or off with the 💡 button beside the tabs in the meeting window. They need a Parley Cloud sign-in, because Parley Cloud picks the line.
- The 教練 tab is now a running list of suggestions, newest at the bottom. Earlier ones fade but stay, so you can scroll back to see what was suggested. The meeting window opens on this tab when suggestions are on.
- The mini window shows the current suggestion under the timer when it is on the 教練 tab.
- A suggestion comes from your meeting draft (the questions to ask, "when they say X, steer with Y" branches, and directions to take) or is written for the moment. When nothing fits, Parley stays quiet rather than suggest something weak.
- The old coach findings, the ask-the-coach box and the agenda bar are gone from the meeting window; the background sheet keeps only 補充背景.

**Meeting drafts carry a playbook** (#722)

- A draft now has its questions (the agenda is that one list), branches and directions. AI assistants filling a draft through MCP can write them too.

**How many suggestions you used** (#724)

- The 表達 tab of a recording lists the live suggestions it showed and marks the ones you went on to say, with a link to the moment you said each.

**Under the hood**

- Secondary windows (the meeting window, voice typing and others) no longer write saved settings, which stops them from echoing changes back and forth with the main window (#729).
- Trial builds can start signed in to a local Parley Cloud; release builds compile this out (#726).
